Intégrer une culture IA au service de la transformation des leaders sectoriels Grâce à des formations IA continues et un écosystème technologique de pointe, reposant sur une expertise métier reconnue. review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Superintendent (Fixed term 12 months)
review_candidates.description: The Infrastructure Superintendent excels in on-site leadership and supervision of camp infrastructure and architectural building projects. Stationed full-time at the construction site, this role ensures that building works are executed safely, on time, within budget, and to specified quality standards. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Key Responsibilities Direct and supervise day-to-day all field operations including camp facilities, buildings, and civil works, ensuring work is executed according to approved plans and specifications. Perform routine site inspections to track progress, identify potential issues, and maintain smooth workflow across teams. Promote and enforce protocols and quality control procedures to ensure full compliance with industry, regulatory, and company standards. Manage costs to remain within budget. Approve commitments and costs in accordance with Delegation of Authority. Following cost control and change management procedures. Manage the work progress to complete on schedule. Coordinate with supervisors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure timely delivery of materials and seamless site logistics. Prepare daily or weekly reports summarizing construction progress, workforce deployment, equipment usage, and safety observations. Facilitate morning briefings and end-of-day walkthroughs to align the crew and identify next steps. Maintain regular communication with Managers, Engineers, Architects and inspectors to resolve technical issues, approvals, and coordination requirements. Maintain site organization, cleanliness, and professional presentation to uphold safety, efficiency, and client expectations. Duties Implement and manage site safety plans and toolbox talks; monitor adherence to PPE and other safety protocols. Monitor and pace project schedules; adjust site workflows to prevent bottlenecks or delays. Verify quality of work, inspect installations, and ensure alignment with construction drawings, specifications, and standards. Maintain accurate site records and escalate operational issues, risks, or changes requests to management when required. Assist in cost tracking by identifying potential budget variances or deviations and facilitating change order documentation when needed. Verify material deliveries and ensure correct installation. Prepare daily reports of site progress, manpower, and equipment utilization. Support the Camp and NPI area Menager with site-level coordination and issue resolution. Key Responsibilities Oversee day-to-day execution of camp construction, architectural buildings, and related civil/structural works. Ensure safety, quality, and productivity standards are implemented in the field. Supervise subcontractors and site crews during construction. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and not necessarily all inclusive. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Education: Relevant trade qualifications and experience. Engineering degree or tertiary qualifications preferred Relevant experience: 10–15 years of project execution infrastructure projects or similar Experience on projects in West Africa is desirable. Qualification in Civil Engineering (or equivalent relevant discipline). Direct experience managing same or similar type of the projects. Exposure to construction management oversight from the Owner’s perspective, including progress tracking, QA/QC deliverables, and commissioning handover documentation. Strong organisational skills with proven ability to maintain registers. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to prepare clear progress and risk reporting for management. Proactive mindset with a demonstrated ability to take initiative and drive results. Proficiency in project and construction management software (e.g. MS Project, Primavera P6, Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships across contractors, consultants, and Owner’s teams. Commercial awareness with the ability to align contract, progress, and cost outcomes to company objectives.

They are committed to building a fair, compliant and high‑performance workplace culture, and seek an experienced HR leader to strengthen employee relations (ER) and industrial relations (IR) capability across their Malaysia operations. Position: HR Senior Manager/Director, Employee Relations & Industrial Relations Location: Johor Bahru (JB), Malaysia Role summary: As HR Senior Manager/Director, ER & IR, you will lead end‑to‑end employee relations and industrial relations strategy and operations for the JB site and Malaysian workforce. This is a hands‑on leadership role combining case management, policy development, coaching for line managers, and strategic partnership with business and regional HR stakeholders. Union & external stakeholder engagement: Manage relationships with unions, worker representatives and external advisors; lead collective bargaining, negotiation and consultation processes where applicable. Policy & compliance: Develop, review and implement HR policies, employment contracts and local procedures to ensure compliance with Malaysian labor law and company standards. Monitor legislative changes and update practices accordingly. Risk mitigation & governance: Proactively identify ER/IR risks, recommend mitigation strategies, and support incident response including employment litigation or tribunal proceedings in partnership with legal counsel. Coaching & capability building: Provide pragmatic coaching and advisory support to senior leaders and line managers on employee relations matters, disciplinaries, investigations and performance improvement. Build ER capability within HR and management through training and toolkits. Workforce relations programs: Design and implement engagement, morale and industrial stability programs to reduce conflict, improve retention and foster positive employee relations. Data & reporting: Maintain accurate ER case records, analyze trends and provide periodic reports and insights to HR leadership and business stakeholders. Project and change support: Support restructures, site changes, disciplinary / redundancy programs and other HR projects with sound ER/IR governance and fair processes. Partnering: Work closely with regional HR, legal, operations and corporate functions to ensure consistent application of ER/IR standards across the business. Key Requirements: Tertiary qualification in HR, Law or related field; professional HR certification (e.g., CIPD, SHRM) or equivalent is preferred. 12-15+ years’ progressive HR experience with a strong focus on employee relations and industrial relations; experience in manufacturing, logistics, or large site operations is advantageous. Demonstrated experience managing unionized workforces and collective bargaining processes in Malaysia. Strong knowledge of Malaysian employment law, disciplinary/grievance processes, and statutory HR obligations. Proven track record handling complex investigations, disciplinaries and employment tribunals or litigation support. Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation and influencing skills with senior leaders and external parties. High level of emotional intelligence, discretion and ability to manage confidential and sensitive matters. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Bahasa Malaysia or other regional languages is advantageous. Able to work on‑site in Johor Bahru with occasional travel to regional offices as required. Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, matrix environment and able to balance operational casework with strategic initiatives. What Will Make You Competitive: Prior leadership experience overseeing ER/IR teams or programs in a regional or multi‑site environment. Practical experience supporting large‑scale restructures, mass redundancies or complex tribunal/claims. Legal background or experience working closely with employment lawyers (good to have). Demonstrated success building proactive engagement and industrial stability programs that reduce disputes and improve morale. How to Apply: Please apply online or contact Adrian Leong at JAC Recruitment Pte Ltd for confidential enquiries. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to application volume, thank you for your understanding. Adrian Leong JAC Recruitment Pte Ltd EA Personnel: R26160017

Operations & Compliance Oversee daily store operations, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and ensure proper product merchandising. Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. review_candidates.description: Take SASSA’s international growth to the next level as a Export Manager Europe (m/f/d) Growing a brand internationally takes more than finding new customers. It requires a thorough understanding of local markets, strong commercial partnerships, and a clear growth strategy. SASSA Mode is an established lingerie and bodywear brand based in Bad Urach, Germany, and part of the international HVEG Group . We develop commercial collections that balance exceptional quality, comfort, and outstanding value, partnering with leading retail and e-commerce brands across the DACH region and beyond. Our international footprint is expanding rapidly, and we see vast potential to scale even further across Europe. As Export Manager Europe (m/f/d) , you will help us expand both the SASSA brand and our Private Label business internationally. You will strengthen existing key accounts, identify and enter new markets, and build long-term partnerships with retailers and sales partners. Working closely with our management team and colleagues in Germany and the Netherlands, you will have the responsibility and freedom to further shape our European export business. What will you do? You will combine the management of existing accounts with new business development and take an active role in shaping and executing our export strategy. Your responsibilities as a Export Manager Europe include: Managing and further developing key accounts across our existing European export markets. Managing and supporting our sales partners based on relevant sales KPIs and market performance. Further developing and implementing our European export strategy, identifying new markets and establishing the right retail and distribution partnerships. Using your market and customer knowledge to strengthen the positioning of SASSA and identify commercial opportunities for both our brand and Private Label business. Coordinating market launches, aligning collections with local market requirements and developing appropriate pricing strategies. Working closely with Product Development, Marketing and Logistics in Germany, as well as with our central teams within HVEG Group in the Netherlands. What do we offer? At SASSA, you will have the freedom and responsibility to help shape our international growth. As Export Manager Europe you will develop new markets, build long-term partnerships and contribute directly to the further growth of both SASSA and our Private Label business. At the same time, you will be part of the international HVEG Group, giving you the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and share expertise across different markets and locations. We also offer: A responsible international sales position with a high level of autonomy. The opportunity to directly contribute to the further development of SASSA and our Private Label business in Europe. Short lines of communication and direct collaboration with management and other departments. A competitive salary and attractive additional benefits. Flexible working hours and hybrid working options. Personal and professional growth opportunities within SASSA and the international HVEG Group. What you bring to the role With a background in international sales, you comfortably navigate relationships with retailers, key accounts, and European sales partners. You know how to maximise existing commercial partnerships while driving expansion into new markets. You also have: A degree in Business Administration, International Business, or a related field—or equivalent commercial experience. Proven international sales experience, ideally within lingerie, bodywear, fashion, or a related consumer goods sector. Proven experience working with retailers and key accounts, ideally combined with a relevant network within European fashion retail and e-commerce. A good understanding of brand development, market positioning and the commercial differences between various European markets. Professional fluency in both German and English; additional European languages are an advantage. A structured, self-directed approach, a strong commercial and customer-focused drive, and a willingness to travel regularly within Europe. Interested? Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are what drive us forward. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, empowered to be themselves, and supported in their continuous growth. review_candidates.description: Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. At Netflix events are valued as an important tactic in our campaigns and the goal of the team is to drive conversation around Netflix titles, talent and the brand through curated events delivered to a variety of internal and external audiences. The role is for a leader who is equal parts creative architect and operational leader. Someone who loves big ideas and understands the key role events play in storytelling but also knows how to scale excellence across a large complex organization. You will need to have strong cross-functional relationships to lead the team who create, shape, and execute events for Netflix. You have the ability to see the big picture and clearly articulate your vision to internal and external stakeholders. The successful candidate will be curious about promotional efforts - paying attention to creativity, concept, quality, and time constraints - and will seek to add value and improve campaigns with new and innovative event ideas. What You’ll Do Lead Events at scale Ensure every campaign is creatively ambitious, strategically sharp and flawlessly executed whilst being rightsized. Drive consistency and quality across large and diverse event calendar, while allowing space for risk, experimentation and innovation Partner with key stakeholders across multiple disciplines to ensure the impact of the events team is meeting the ever evolving business needs Lead a high performing team Lead a team of leaders, and a team of 20+ understanding the local nuances across the region Set clear standard and direction for the team, without micromanaging - focusing on impactful outcomes rather than process Inspire, develop and empower your team, championing the netflix culture and nurturing the values. Operate with rigour and collaboration Creative approach to solving problems ensuring the team continue to meet the needs of our evolving business Encourage bold thinking that plays to Netflix's unique strengths Push the teams, and cross-functional teams to be deliberate and intentional about when and if an event is the right solution for a campaign Be a key member of the the APAC marketing leadership team Partner seamlessly with cross-function teams including, but not limited to, Marketing, Awards, Communications, and Content teams both in APAC and around the world Help shape the broader marketing culture—setting the tone for collaboration, ambition, and creative excellence. Be an ambassador for the events team in broader forums, ensuring the teams output delivers on company priorities Who You Are An experienced leader with a deep, proven track record, ideally in entertainment, media, or culture-led brands. Equally comfortable dreaming up standout ideas and running complex operations at scale. A natural leader who can motivate large teams, recruit top talent and develop future leaders whilst smartly leveraging team resources for maximum impact An outstanding communicator with strong instincts who can discern what is and is not required to deliver a successful campaign Adaptable, curious, and resilient—energised by change rather than slowed by it. Passionate about the events industry, and whilst you may not be running many live projects in this role, you have the experience and ability to roll up your sleeves and dive in to support the team when needed Experienced working in global organisations, navigating matrixed structures and multiple stakeholders.
